title: TrailRunCoach demo
description: A training coach for trail running, Taiwan's 100 Peaks (Baiyue) and road running: try the schedule, the race calculator and the season plan with a fictional runner.
who_tip: This runner and their year of training, heart rate, power and GPS tracks are all generated by a program and have nothing to do with any real person. Your changes stay in your browser only and are cleared after 24 hours.
who_tip_static: This runner and their year of training, heart rate, power and GPS tracks are all generated by a program and have nothing to do with any real person. This is a read-only static demo: you can try editing the schedule, and your changes stay in your browser only.
h1: A training coach for trail running, Taiwan's 100 Peaks (Baiyue) and road running
lead: See how your training is going from your watch data, get an automatic schedule, and estimate race pace and power. Here you can try it with a fictional runner.
sched.prefs: Adjust schedule preferences (long-run day, rest days)
sched.prefs_static: Add and delete sessions, set rest days
sched.steps: See each session's steps and target power
race.builtin: Built in: a road half marathon, a 50K trail race, a 3-day Baiyue trip
race.gpx_static: The quick options' results are precomputed
race.legs: Pace, power and fueling per leg
season.add_static: How races (A / B / C) are planned
season.phases: Base, build, specific and taper phases
season.replan: The schedule is rebuilt to follow the phases
off: Watch sync, pushing workouts and share links are turned off in the demo.
off_static: Read-only demo: schedule changes stay in this browser only; sync, push, upload, sharing and season-plan changes don't work here.
ex.race: See a trail race (GPX) calculation example
